text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership didn't show up for training.
She's been slacking off a lot lately,
so I go to pick her up and give her a stern talking-to.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Trainer!?
What's with the scary face...
I-It's not like I was planning to play games or anything...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I know! This is "preserving physical resources"...
a tactic looking towards the long game!
choice_data_list: "Rules" are meant to be strictly followed, right?
"Rules" are meant to be strictly followed, right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
......*sigh*, you're right.
On the board, rules are absolute.
My bad...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave them a stern talking-to
to ensure they would never do the same thing again.
